overall_reason: The 'Upload file' to 'Uploaded' label travels as one 28 px track on a 480 ms ease-out inside a window whose edges fade, so the labels pass through the edges without being cut.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY and T-MOTION-SYSTEM pass with one track, one curve and masked edges; the roll's middle is caught in only one still.

strengths: In the 1615 ms still the label's luminance ramps from 107 to 224 over the bottom rows and from 226 to 172 at the top edge: the window masks its edges, so no glyph is sliced.
The button holds 112 px, and only the label track moves.
not_investigated: Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
